answer: Canyon-vault layered bond: each identity locks 75 credits in three layers. The canyon layer (25) unlocks on a first task at a canyon post; the vault layer (25) on a second task in the vault; the jetty layer (25) on a jetty attestation. A rented-layer ring bears its owner's signature, so one signature on two identities burns both. First fake costs 75, the k-th 75+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,072,000 on a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 75 once.
